Introduction to Barley Grass Powder

Barley grass powder is made from the young green leaves of the barley plant, dried and fine milled for use in green drink blends, supplements and snack bars. Tradenest Naturals is a barley grass powder supplier in Surat, India, supplying food and supplement brands that buy in bulk. Our buyers are mostly importers, contract packers and brand owners in North America, the UK and Europe. As a barley grass powder exporter, we work with a range of buyer specifications and pack formats. The young shoots are harvested before the plant matures, when the leaves are still tender and bright green. This gives the finished powder its fresh colour and mild grassy taste. Samples are available on request.

Processing and Quality Excellence

The process is simple and closely controlled. Raw leaves are carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. They are washed and cleaned under documented food-safety practices. They are then dried gently to hold on to the natural green colour. After drying, the leaves are fine milled and sieved. If you are looking for a bulk barley grass powder supplier India, this is where consistency matters most: an even particle size across every batch. Moisture and mesh are checked before each batch is released. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. Our barley grass powder wholesale grade is packed for export from our FSSAI registered facility.

Key Specifications and Features

Buyers need dependable parameters in a green ingredient. Our powder is fine milled to 80-100 mesh, which mixes well into drinks and blends. Moisture is held below 5.0% to limit caking. The colour comes from the leaf itself, with no added dyes or fillers. Shelf life is 24 months in sealed packs.

Applications Across Multiple Industries

Barley grass powder fits into many product types. Food manufacturers use it in green smoothie blends and snack bars. Supplement companies use it for capsules and tablets. Beverage brands add it to instant green drinks and protein shakes. Some cosmetic formulators also use leaf powders in face masks and natural skin care products. Our clear b2b barley grass powder price structure helps brand owners plan their costs. The powder blends easily into most dry manufacturing processes.

Packaging, Logistics, and Buyer Value

Good packaging protects the powder during international transit. We offer export packaging such as multi-wall paper bags and HDPE drums. Each pack has a food-grade liner to keep out moisture and light. Shelf life is 24 months when stored correctly. Buyers often ask about minimum orders. The MOQ is 5 Kg, and OEM and private label packing is available on separate terms. As an IEC registered exporter, we provide export documentation support for customs clearance. Contact our sales team to request a sample or a quote.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the minimum order quantity for barley grass powder?

The MOQ is 5 Kg. We are happy to supply trial quantities before regular bulk orders.

What are the typical specifications for this powder?

It is fine milled to 80-100 mesh, with moisture below 5.0%. The standard grade is plain barley grass leaf powder with no additives.

What are the packaging and shelf-life options?

We pack in export cartons or HDPE drums with food-grade liners. Shelf life is 24 months when stored cool and dry.

How do I request a sample or quote?

Send an enquiry through our website. Our sales team will reply with pricing, the product specification sheet and sample availability.
